metadata.description: Claude Code mods made at Accordion.

plugins.name: hockey-avatar
plugins.description: Clawd plays hockey on a rink above the prompt; /rink shows the score.

plugins.name: token-ledger
plugins.description: Per-turn cost and token ledger: a pinned status line with session cost and cache hit ratio; /ledger shows recent turns.

plugins.name: blast-radius-win
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel. Patched for Windows.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: /handoff writes what's done, what's next and which files matter, then starts a fresh chat from that note.

plugins.name: team-tracker
plugins.description: A /team pane: to-do progress bar and every helper agent Claude sends off, with runtime and rough cost.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Catches a correction like 'never do that' and offers to save it as a permanent rule in CLAUDE.md or a skill.
